Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The change affects generated toolpaths and thus posted G-code.

What looks good:
- The new start stays on the same ring polygon.
- The kernel checks the actual descents with the existing crossing law.
- The app test keeps the gouge checks for the two small-radius rows.
- No golden, fixture, importer, UI, dependency, or process file changes occur in this PR.

## Requested before merge

1. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/circular.rs:285` — Supply the required heavy-lane results. The PR body says that these lanes did not run. The current upstream AGENTS.md requires each reached heavy lane to pass on the final head before the PR is ready. The local plan selects motion and app, with 235 steps. Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the final head. Add the lane names and results to the PR body. Supply the review light-lane results too. A dry run is not a pass.

## Local build and test results

Base: `c310c4f615f6069967a83c82a6d79b47600d29d5` (upstream/main).
Head: `aa6022822a6a437611bb503a8305624efb7e45b1`.
The trial merge had no conflicts. All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3112`. No GitHub runner ran.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 134 steps; 133 passed; one failed. Time: 38.7 minutes. Both crate builds passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 8 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed, with `RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache`.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`: selected 235 steps across motion and app. The heavy tests did not run. The light tests did not run.
- After source restoration, `cargo test -j 8 -p camcraft-motion --test circular_helix_rings`: all four tests passed. The worktree had no source changes.

The quick gate failed in `motion:vertical_arc_entry`. The same suite also failed on upstream/main alone, with the same two test names and assertions. These are baseline failures, not findings against the Circular change:

```text
an_x_aligned_first_cut_enters_on_one_g18_arc_per_level
  crates/motion/tests/vertical_arc_entry.rs:176
  assertion `left == right` failed: recorded path .../vertical_arc_x.cl is stale

an_oblique_first_cut_stays_chords_and_says_so_once
  crates/motion/tests/vertical_arc_entry.rs:214
  each level still descends on a chord fan

test result: FAILED. 1 passed; 2 failed; 0 ignored
```

## Extra suites run

- Baseline check: `cargo test -j 8 -p camcraft-motion --test vertical_arc_entry` on upstream/main. One passed; two failed as above.
- Restored source: `cargo test -j 8 -p camcraft-motion --test circular_helix_rings`. Four passed.
- The fixture and importer rules select no extra suites. This PR changes neither fixtures nor import code. The STEP fixture-row rule does not apply.

## Mutations

- Stagger off: force the ring phase to zero. Three tests failed: `a_multi_ring_helix_circular_has_no_crossing`, `the_issue_job_verifies_without_crossings`, and `every_ring_still_reaches_the_floor`. Each received the named crossing refusal. The named-refusal test passed.
- Refusal off: disable only the crossing-hit predicate in `Descents::add`. Keep the descent records and staggering. `a_helix_that_cannot_stand_apart_is_refused_by_name` failed because generation returned a path with ten crossing pairs.
- Restore both changes: all four tests passed. No mutation was committed.

## Goldens

No `.nc`, `.cl`, fixture, or golden file changed. There are no moved golden lines to check. The changed app test passed. Its radius 4 and radius 6 rows still assert a gouge with plunge entry.

The missing heavy-lane results block a clean verdict. Keep this PR as a draft.
A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the missing heavy-lane results and light-lane results.

- Heavy: `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` passed. All 234 steps passed. Motion passed 57 ordinary tests. App passed 43. Six expected-failure checks also passed. The PR body lists each lane and its result.
- Light: `cargo xtask gate light` passed. The test `machining2d::adaptive::tests::the_slot_keeps_its_verdict_under_sub_micron_perturbations_light` passed.
- Quick: 133 steps passed. Clippy passed for `camcraft-motion` and `camcraft-app` with `-D warnings`.

Head remains `aa6022822a6a437611bb503a8305624efb7e45b1`. The finding requested verification only. No new source pin or mutation was needed.

The PR body has the results on this unchanged head. Please re-review this PR.

Takeover refresh (clear-out lane). We pushed the head `ae21bb0ec`. It is a merge of `origin/main` into `aa6022822`. There were no conflicts and no hand edits. Expected delta class: SAME.

The review finding asked for the heavy-lane and light-lane results. We ran them on this head:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 134 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main`: 236 steps, 0 failed. The lanes were motion heavy and app heavy, every target. Six known-fail markers were red as expected.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 3 steps, 0 failed.

The PR body has the table. The PR stays a draft. It needs a new review on this head.

Review: clean (the finding of the aa6022822 review is met)

Read-only delta review of head `ae21bb0ec`. This review did not build, edit, push or set labels.

1. The new head is only a merge of `origin/main`.
   - `ae21bb0ec` merges `5e76e6a14` (main) into `c238c6905`. `c238c6905` merges main into `aa6022822`.
   - `git show --remerge-diff` is empty for the two merges.
   - There is no new commit other than `aa6022822`.
   - The changed lines in `circular.rs` and `mod.rs` between `aa6022822` and `ae21bb0ec` come from main (`equal_steps`, #9998a1c82 line of work, and `chamfer_wall_lean`). They are not changes of this PR.
   - The PR diff on the seven PR files (against its merge base) is identical before and after the merges: 669 changed lines each, no difference.
   - Class: SAME.
2. The finding is met. The section "Verification on the takeover head" records these results on `ae21bb0ec`:
   - `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 134 steps, 0 failed.
   - clippy on `camcraft-motion` and `camcraft-app`, `--all-targets -D warnings`: clean.
   - `cargo xtask gate heavy --base origin/main`: 236 steps, 0 failed, motion heavy and app heavy.
   - `cargo xtask gate light`: 3 steps, 0 failed.
3. The six red tests are the gate's known-fail markers, not new failures.
   - Each test has `#[ignore = "known-fail #N | ..."]` on `origin/main`: `pocket_hsm_ring.rs` (2, #1950), `pocket3d_hsm.rs` (1, #1950), `lead_approach.rs` (2, #2849), `shoulder_adaptive.rs` (1, #2849).
   - #1950 and #2849 are open.
   - The PR diff adds or changes no `#[ignore]` and no known-fail marker.
4. The code of the PR did not change after the review on `aa6022822`. The other results of that review stay valid.

No blockers.

Ready and merge: the coordinator flags head ae21bb0ec ready and merges it. Review: the clean review on this head (comment 7067299614: the finding of mkinney's aa6022822 review is met; the PR code is unchanged since his review).
